evidence.observation: Pressure steady at ~2.90 Torr through the ramp and early growth at 100 sccm Ar
Pressure rose steadily and is speeding up: 2.97 -> 3.00 -> 3.05 -> 3.09 -> 3.175 Torr, with no setpoint change
MFC reads ~100 sccm, matching setpoint, so the rise is not caused by more gas flowing in
Temperature holds 750 C with stable heater power (~44%), so the thermal side is normal

args.missing_evidence: No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so I can't tell a seal leak (air getting in, O2 would rise) from an exhaust or pump-line blockage (O2 would stay flat). A leak check / rate-of-rise test with the valve closed, or inspecting the exhaust line and pump, would settle it.
